misprints.note: Under Uttala 3) the print has λύγου. It is kept as printed.

uncertain.note: The first letter is broken type and looks like 'a'. It is read as 'u' (utkräfva), which is the only sensible word.
The print has stray vertical marks after 'tjena' and 'en', probably spacing material that took ink. They are left out.
The first τ is damaged and looks like ι. It is read as τεταγμένον.
It is hard to tell whether the η carries an iota subscript or only the hook of the glyph. The reading ῃ is kept.
The line ends after the parenthesis with a hyphen. Both are treated as line-break hyphens and the words are joined.
